evidence.claim: SeatFlow, a seating chart maker app, sells a Lifetime unlock for $17.99 and a Weekly plan for $2.99 as in-app purchases.
PlanSeats charges $8.99 a month for its Planner plan and $50 one time for Planner Lifetime, with a free Starter tier.

A WeddingWire forum thread complains an update to its seating chart tool removed features like dragging whole parties and room and table size inputs, and the poster planned to use a different seating chart generator.
A WeddingWire forum thread active until July 2025 reports the seating planner only seats whole households and that guests disappeared from the planner.

title: Seatwise
oneLiner: Plan a wedding seating chart on your phone in minutes, private, no signup
customer: Couples and family members planning a wedding or large event seating
revenueModel: Free planner, one-time paid Pro unlock (price pending owner approval)

evidence.claim: Dink! Pickleball Round Robins sells Premium Annual for $24.99 and Premium Permanent access for $39.99 as in-app purchases, with 17 ratings averaging 4.6.
Pickleheads charges players $19.99 a year or $2.99 a month for Plus, which unlocks unlimited round robins, tournaments, leagues and ladders for organisers.

title: Rally Rounds
oneLiner: Pickleball round robin schedules and live scores for club organisers, no app install
customer: Volunteer pickleball and padel session organisers
revenueModel: Free for small sessions, paid organiser pass
nextAction: Research: find a third independent signal and a community that welcomes tools. Against: many free generators exist

title: Paychase
oneLiner: Polite payment reminder sequence and overdue tracker for Indian freelancers
customer: Indian freelancers with clients who pay late
nextAction: Research: find people paying for payment chasing tools. Legal: no claims about statutory interest without owner legal approval

title: Shaadi Budget
oneLiner: Indian wedding budget planner by function and vendor, works offline
nextAction: Research: evidence of paid Indian wedding budget planners. Overlaps Seatwise audience, could be a Seatwise add-on

title: Rota Sheet
